section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the concept of cutting a covenant in the soul involves drawing from a level above reason, unifying opposites, similar to the physical covenant of passing between the parts.
section.t: And from this will be understood the concept of the cutting of a covenant in the aspect of the soul,
for just as the concept of a covenant in its simple sense is that it draws from a matter that is above reason and intellect,
therefore no change at all applies to it, and it is established,
for through this opposites are unified,
and as explained in Likkutei Torah28
that by passing between the parts they become unified as one actual unity,29

in this way will be understood the concept of the cutting of a covenant in the soul, that for the unification of the hidden and revealed aspects of the soul, there needs to be the matter of a covenant, which is the drawing from a most supernal place in the soul
(in the manner explained above regarding the Torah).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the covenant before entering the Land of Israel was a special covenant needed for the descent into the lowest level of action, beyond the covenant at Chorev.
section.t: And this is also the concept of the cutting of a covenant in the aspect of the world before entering the land in its simple sense,
"For you are coming to the land... and you will inherit it and dwell in it."
For it is explained in many places30
that the concept of entering the Land of Israel was the descent from the world of thought or from the world of speech to the world of action,
a descent to the lowest level, to a land that consumes its inhabitants,31
and since there needed to be a connection of the highest high with the lowest low,
therefore there needed to be beforehand a special cutting of a covenant, beyond the covenant which He cut with them at Chorev,
for even after the covenant at Chorev they were still the generation of knowledge32
(the aspect of thought or the aspect of speech),
but here there needed to be a descent to the lowest level,
until they caused the land to be very, very good,33
behold, for this there needed to be a special cutting of a covenant.34

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that just as there is a covenant in soul and world, so too in the year before Rosh Hashanah, a new covenant is needed to draw from the highest peak to the lowest, unifying all of Israel with Atzmus.
section.t: And behold, just as there is the concept of the cutting of a covenant in the soul and in the world, so too is it in the year,
for on Rosh Hashanah is the aspect of entering the Land of Israel in the year,35
and every year before Rosh Hashanah there needs to be a new cutting of a covenant.
And the concept is,
behold, on Rosh Hashanah is the completion of the service of man,
for then the Holy One, blessed be He, says "Make Me king over you,"36
[for the decision regarding the creation of the world is through the souls of Israel, as the statement37
"With whom did He consult? With the souls of the righteous,"
and "Your people are all righteous,"38
and as explained at length in the Torah of the Maggid of Mezeritch, in Or Torah and in Likkutei Amarim at its beginning,39
that through the delight from the service of the righteous rising before Him, etc., like the parable of the father who pictures to himself his small son, etc.
And so it is every Rosh Hashanah, that the coronation is specifically through Israel],
and through this is the decision that He be King over the entire world.
And from the decision of Rosh Hashanah, it is drawn to all the days of the year,
therefore it is called "Rosh Hashanah" (Head of the Year) and not "Beginning of the Year,"
as explained at length in Ateret Rosh at its beginning,40
that it is analogous to the head which includes all the limbs,
and also afterward, when the limbs are each in their place, the head is what leads them,
for so it is on Rosh Hashanah, which leads all the days of the year,
and even extends into actual deed.
This is the concept of drawing from one extreme to the other extreme.
And also, the entire concept of the decision to be King is drawn through the coronation of the souls of Israel, whose root is above, even above Torah,
and from there it is drawn downward specifically through a ruling of law in the Torah,
namely the instructions in the Torah regarding actual deed,
and in order to arrive at a true ruling, one must exert oneself to reach the truth in its truth
(as explained in the continuation of the discourse for Rosh Hashanah that falls on Shabbat from the holy Rebbe, of blessed memory,41
and in the discourses of my father-in-law, the Rebbe, the Nasi of our generation, who fills his place),
behold, all this is a drawing from the highest extreme to the lowest extreme.
Therefore, there needs to be beforehand a concept of a special cutting of a covenant,
for through the cutting of a covenant, all of the children of Israel
(and "Your people are all righteous")
become one with Atzmus and Essence,
in the analogy of a simple physical covenant.
